term_en: Ctrl / Cmd / Alt / Option / Esc / Enter
zh: Ctrl / Cmd / Alt / Option / Esc / Enter
definition: Names of keyboard keys shown in shortcuts.
note: Keep as printed on the keyboard.

definition: The infinite drawing surface where elements are placed.
The background colour of the canvas.
Everything currently on the canvas, saved or shared as one unit (a file or link).
note: Alt: 画布内容. Distinct from canvas (the surface) and drawing (the user's work).

definition: The user's work as a whole, as in 'collaborate on your drawing'.
Any single object on the canvas: shape, line, text, image.
A geometric element such as rectangle, diamond or ellipse.
The elements currently selected.
note: Alt: 选区. 'Add element to selection' = 将元素添加到选中内容.

definition: Combine selected elements so they move as one; also the result.
A container element that holds and clips other elements, like an artboard.
note: Alt: 框架. Follows design-tool usage (Figma zh: 画框).

definition: A shape that text is bound to and wraps inside.
Stacking order of elements.
A panel of reusable elements the user saves or imports.
One saved reusable element set in the library.
Connector element with an arrowhead.
The end marker of an arrow or line (arrow, bar, dot, cardinality…).
Arrows attaching to shapes so they move with them.
Arrow made of right-angle segments.
Arrow drawn as a curve.
A line element. Ambiguous: also 'line' in a line chart and a line of text.
note: Line chart = 折线图; line of text = 行. Check context each time.

definition: Tool for panning the canvas.
Tool that removes elements it touches.
Temporary highlight for presenting.
A note element with background colour.
Element that embeds a live web page (YouTube, Figma…).
note: Embed = 嵌入; embeddable link = 可嵌入链接.

definition: Trimming an image element's visible area.
AI feature that turns a wireframe frame into code.
The outline of an element.
note: Stroke width = 描边宽度; stroke style = 描边样式.

definition: How hand-drawn (rough) strokes look: architect, artist, cartoonist.
note: Alt: 线条风格, 手绘程度. Decide by Excalidraw's playful tone.

definition: How transparent an element is.
Typeface used by text elements.
Control for choosing a colour.
Six-digit hexadecimal colour value.
User's pinned favourite colours or fonts.
note: Alt: 精选. 'Top picks' list = 常用列表.

definition: Change magnification of the canvas.
Background grid for alignment.
Automatically align to objects, midpoints or grid.
Read-only mode with editing tools hidden.
Distraction-free mode that hides most UI.
Dark colour theme.

System clipboard for copy and paste.
Save the scene or an image out of Excalidraw.

'Made with Excalidraw' mark added to exports.
Diagram of steps joined by arrows.

A data chart pasted from a spreadsheet.
How many entities one relationship end allows (one, many…).
Three-pronged arrowhead meaning 'many' in ER diagrams.
